answer: Because the ember solution is checked at the pigment gate and logged, the jetty audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 237 pays that 26 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
